summary: Publix Super Markets filed an 8-K reporting two routine corporate events: entry into an indemnification agreement with a director and declaration of a quarterly dividend of $0.116 per share. The indemnification agreement is standard and identical to prior agreements with all directors and officers. The quarterly dividend of 11.6 cents per share is payable August 3, 2026 to holders of record July 15, 2026. Neither event constitutes a special situation; the filing is a routine current report covering a director indemnification and a regular dividend declaration, with no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return plan, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or management change.
